verdict.rationale: Lithic's Authorization Rules v2 let ops apply logic based on 'risk score' among other signals at auth time (docs-17/26), and ASA provides a custom real-time decisioning hook using transaction metadata (docs-2/16), which covers part of the fraud-scoring-at-auth story. However, there is no evidence of dedicated suspicious-activity alerting, network fraud-score surfacing beyond a generic 'risk score' attribute, or explicit card block/reissue tooling for compromised cards — only generic card creation (docs-9) and spend-limit velocity controls (docs-13) are documented. Missing for 10: explicit suspicious-activity alert mechanism, documented card block/reissue workflow, and clarity on network (Visa/Mastercard) fraud score integration versus Lithic's own risk score field.
